report.status_line: Caution: Suit helmet latches compromised, gasoline containers empty, and water flow meter filter blocked.

concerns.title: Suit helmet latch failures
concerns.detail: The latch on the back of helmet 6 is broken, the rear latch on helmet 2/3 does not snap into place and requires tape to maintain a secure connection, and some helmet latches fail to properly attach to the suit.

concerns.title: Blocked filter in water flow meter
concerns.detail: A blocked filter was found in the water flow meter between the loft tank valve and the pump after crew removed the flow meter.

concerns.title: ATV gasoline containers empty
concerns.detail: Both containers of gasoline are empty following refueling of the ATVs.

crew_actions: Quarantine helmet 6 from EVA rotation until the broken rear latch can be repaired.
Tape helmet 2/3 rear latch securely if required for suit operations.
Clean and clear debris from the water flow meter filter before reassembly.
Apply visor anti-fogging measures to mitigate ongoing helmet fogging issues.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Determine EVA clearance rules and helmet usage restrictions for suits with loose or taped latches.
decisions_for_earth.why: Damaged and loose helmet latches compromise suit integrity and crew safety during EVAs.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Decide whether to authorize a gasoline resupply for the ATVs before mission end on 2015-01-23.
decisions_for_earth.why: Both containers of gasoline are empty, preventing additional ATV refueling for motorized field operations during the remaining 2 days.

report.message_to_earth: MDRS Crew 147 is in caution status due to compromised EVA helmet latches. On 2015-01-21, the rear latch on helmet 6 broke, while both containers of gasoline were emptied after refueling the ATVs. Additionally, crew found a blocked filter in the water flow meter between the loft tank valve and the pump. The crew taped helmet 2/3 to secure its loose latch and inspected the water flow meter filter. Other habitat systems are nominal with propane at 32%, diesel at 60%, and static water depth at 20 cm. Request guidance by tomorrow morning on EVA clearances given the damaged helmet latches. Next report tomorrow evening.
